description: Render the Table of Contents structure using nested Markdown bullet points and correct anchor links.
spec:
1. Iterate through all successfully parsed headings (with slugs).
2. Maintain the current nesting depth based on heading level (# vs ## vs ###).3. Render a nested Markdown list structure using appropriate indentation and bullet points.
4. Links must use the generated slug for the anchor.
title: Rendering correctly structured TOC markdown
